# tempo ratio expression

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:tempoRatioExpression`](gmeow-tempoRatioExpression.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/tempoRatioExpression>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/music`](../../slices/music.md)

A canonical symbolic expression for an irrational tempo ratio (e.g. "sqrt(2)/2"), stored as a literal and never reasoner-parsed. The generated decimal approximation is [`tempoRatioApprox`](gmeow-tempoRatioApprox.md) ([Principle 4](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-4)).

## Structure

**Property shape:** datatype property; [`gmeow:TimeMapping`](../classes/gmeow-TimeMapping.md) -> [`xsd:string`](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#string); functional

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:tempoRatioExpression`](gmeow-tempoRatioExpression.md) from [`gmeow:TimeMapping`](../classes/gmeow-TimeMapping.md) to [`xsd:string`](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#string) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.
